scenarios.name: Inspect metadata in the recent-document list

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
recent documents are displayed in List View
the recent list contains a part and a drawing
the user inspects the recent-document list
the list has Name, Location, Date Modified, Last Opened and Size headers
the part row shows its name, location, dates and size
the part and drawing rows show different document-type symbols
